exposure: Beliefs and perceptions about cesarean section (CS)
Views on decision-making regarding mode of delivery
outcome: Preferred decision-maker for mode of delivery
cohort: 200 pregnant women in Enugu, Southeast Nigeria
finding: While most pregnant women in Enugu, Southeast Nigeria believe CS is for the safety of the mother and baby, cultural factors influence their acceptance and decision-making regarding mode of delivery, with a preference for joint decision-making.
